I park the custom pink hearse by the curb, bubblegum curse
My Sri Lankan island doll in Dior with a coffin purse
Skittles on the Prada, Nerds on the chain
Madame Cocoa conducts the chocolate rain
Lego heels click, Barbie Jeep, sweet talk
Baron Bonbon on the cocoa walk
He can keep the title king and his little ring
I’m the woman taking territory, conquering everything
Switch—rip the mask, I’m chewing brains, it’s insane
Goblins, ghouls, zombies, vampires drinking the vein
Who made the industry this bloody and insane?
Crack every skull of the competition, eat the brain
Cannibal syllables, pitiful, minimal, criminal, eating the brain
Swallow the pen, swallow the chain, swallow the reign
I take the wheel and devour the fame
Who is responsible for the industry? Who made it insane?
Veterans. Sit. Listen.
You call me rookie. Ten times your rate. You’re finished.
50,000 currency units. One feature. One verse.
No debut studio album. Still that fee. No reverse.
Old heads. Check the wire. Ten times the pay.
My stack is a tower. Your ladder is in the way.
Climb it. Climb it. Rope. Harness. Look up.
Acknowledge financial dominance. Money over your luck.
Headlock, neck-lock, kidnap the game, put the whole scene in the trunk of the whip
Look-at-me, watch-me, see-me, eyes-on-me, listeners, don’t blink, don’t dip
From the hearse to Dubai, Burj Khalifa, global abduction, worldwide grip
Submit to the bubblegum horror, the fusion, confusion, intrusion, whip and the flip
I snatch the mic, lock the room, swallow the key, abduction, eruption, no return from the trip
Competitors, look-at-me, look-at-me, look-at-me, watch-me, watch-me, burn
I’M A MONSTER!
tee-hee…
